# WillowinWorlds

> WillowinWorlds is an independent mobile game studio making puzzle and arcade games. It has four flagship games (Nature Seed, Candy Shop, Paint Blasters and Ball is God?!) and eight lab prototypes.

Nature Seed was released on 2026-09-18 and is playable free in the browser on [itch.io](https://willowinworlds.itch.io/nature-seed), [Game Jolt](https://gamejolt.com/games/nature-seed/1100526) and [indiexpo](https://www.indiexpo.net/en/games/nature-seed). The other three flagship games are in development. The target platforms are iOS and Android. The game pages below are the source of truth for genre, scope, status, characters, gameplay and media assets. No rating or review score is claimed unless a game page publishes one. This guide is in English; the language index below lists the localized sites. Latest source update: 2026-09-18.

## Games

- [Nature Seed](https://willowinworlds.com/games/nature-seed.html): A mobile draw-to-solve physics puzzle, released on 18 September 2026. Players draw a line with a limited ink budget, bring Water Drop and Seed together and restore a watercolor forest across 100 levels. Genres: Draw-to-solve puzzle, Physics puzzle, Relaxing puzzle, Line drawing puzzle. Current status: Released.
- [Candy Shop](https://willowinworlds.com/games/candy-shop.html): A cozy mobile candy merge puzzle with a 13-stage candy chain, 10 containers with their own rules, eight special-candy effects, a landing preview, a hold slot and a next-three queue. Genres: Merge puzzle, Candy puzzle, Casual puzzle, Physics puzzle. Current status: Active development - playable production build.
- [Paint Blasters](https://willowinworlds.com/games/paint-blasters.html): A mobile color-destruction physics puzzle arcade. Players mix three colors into one of 35 projectile recipes, aim at weak points in a tower and set off chain reactions. Genres: Color puzzle, Physics arcade, Destruction puzzle, Chain reaction. Current status: Active development - production prototype.
- [Ball is God?!](https://willowinworlds.com/games/ball-is-god.html): A story-driven hardcore vertical-descent mobile arcade. Players drag to rotate the tower around the falling Espa, skip three platforms for a combo smash, face bosses and make karma choices across 10 locations. Genres: Vertical descent arcade, Hardcore arcade, Story-driven arcade, Boss action. Current status: Active production.

## In development

Prototypes with English-only pages. None is released yet; scope and status may change.

- [BlastBlast!](https://willowinworlds.com/games/blastblast.html): Genre: One-button physics runner. Current status: Vertical slice.
- [Vacuum Shot](https://willowinworlds.com/games/vacuum-shot.html): Genre: Endless recoil-flight arcade. Current status: Vertical slice.
- [Burger Stack](https://willowinworlds.com/games/burger-stack.html): Genre: Arcade stacking game. Current status: Prototype.
- [Sandwich Stack](https://willowinworlds.com/games/sandwich-stack.html): Genre: Arcade stacking game. Current status: Prototype.
- [Scooter Mechanic Simulator](https://willowinworlds.com/games/scooter-mechanic-simulator.html): Genre: Repair shop simulator. Current status: Prototype.
- [Alien Flying](https://willowinworlds.com/games/alien-flying.html): Genre: Endless tunnel flyer. Current status: Early prototype.
- [Lyamur](https://willowinworlds.com/games/lyamur.html): Genre: Marble shooter. Current status: Early prototype.
- [Stack Tower](https://willowinworlds.com/games/stack-tower.html): Genre: One-tap tower stacker. Current status: Early prototype.

## Latest development notes

- [Nature Seed - Nature Seed release](https://willowinworlds.com/games/nature-seed.html#devlog): Published 2026-09-18. Nature Seed launched under its final title as a free browser game on itch.io, Game Jolt and indiexpo, with 100 levels, line-efficiency stars and saved progress.
- [Candy Shop - Production menu and HUD pass](https://willowinworlds.com/games/candy-shop.html#devlog): Published 2026-07-31. The main menu, level selection, HUD controls and command icons now share one look, and more in-engine stress tests cover the updated flow.
- [Paint Blasters - Physics and effect stability pass](https://willowinworlds.com/games/paint-blasters.html#devlog): Published 2026-07-31. Projectile behavior, Match-3 resolution and hit effects were tested and tightened for more consistent combo outcomes.
- [Ball is God?! - World surfaces and hazard validation](https://willowinworlds.com/games/ball-is-god.html#devlog): Published 2026-07-31. Character presentation, deterministic generation and thorn hazards got a combined visual and validation pass.
